bibl.title: Six Coptic Funerary Stelae with the Commemorative Day Formula from the Abou El-Goud Storage Magazine.
bibl.seg: Ahmed T.A. Khalil, Six Coptic Funerary Stelae with the Commemorative Day Formula from the Abou El-Goud Storage Magazine.
bibl.note: Introduction. - 1. Epitaph of Mina, a monk (AD 866). - 2. Epitaph of Aaron, a monk. - 3. Epitaph of Athanasius, a monk. - 4. Fragment of an epitaph of Gragorios, a father. - 5. Fragment of an epitaph of an unknown person (AD 763). - 6. Fragment of an epitaph of an unknown person, a hegumenos (?) (AD 758). - Conclusion.
